exact.Ls 为太阳黄经：0° 北半球春分、90° 夏至、180° 秋分、270° 冬至: Ls is solar longitude: 0° is the northern spring equinox, 90° the summer solstice, 180° the autumn equinox, 270° the winter solstice. Mars's axial tilt is 25.19°, so its seasons swing wider than Earth's; a Martian year is 686.98 Earth days (~668.6 sols), and one sol is 24 h 39 m 35 s. In the default “browse” mode the Sun follows the camera; with real daylight on, the night hemisphere darkens naturally and the terminator moves with the clock.
exact.颜色来自火面反照率与矿物成分：氧化铁让大部分地表偏橙红，古老高地偏亮，玄武岩平原: Colour comes from surface albedo and mineral composition: iron oxide gives most of the surface its orange-red cast, ancient highlands read brighter, and basalt plains and dust-covered regions read darker; the white at both poles is the water-ice and dry-ice cap. The dark region Syrtis Major was already visible through early telescopes and remains the most striking landmark.
